annotation.bound_parties_text: The policy is a strategy document that sets objectives and planned activities for the state, society, companies, science and the public sector, without imposing binding obligations on named parties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The overarching aim of the AI Policy is to support the society, companies, representatives of the academia and public administration in taking advantage of opportunities related to AI development
annotation.dates_quote: no. 196 of the Council of Ministers of 28 December 2020 (item 23)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The “Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020”, which will hereinafter be referred to as the “AI Policy
